FULL TEXT:
STENOGRAPHER RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION, 2025
NOTICE
No.- 01/R&A Dated: 08th January, 2026
This is for information to all concerned that Computer Based Written Test (comprising English
Shorthand-Computer Typing Test, Multiple Choice Question based Objective Test and English Computer
Typing Test) under the Stenographer Recruitment Examination, 2025 (Advertisement No.
PHC/02/2025) was held on 22.12.2025 (Monday) in three shifts at four examination centres situated
in Patna.
The Questions and Provisional Answer Keys of the Multiple Choice Questions have been
uploaded on the official website of the High Court i.e.
https://patnahighcourt.gov.in/notices/recruitments. Candidates may login through the provided link
and click the Question tab for viewing the questions and provisional answer keys.
A candidate, who has appeared in this examination and wishes to raise an objection regarding
any question and/or the Provisional Answer may submit an objection through the link available on the
official website of the High Court from 09.01.2026 (From 12:00 p.m.) to 15.01.2026 (up to 11:59
p.m.). The objection must be supported by a copy of authentic source document(s)/proof on the basis
of which it is being submitted.
Candidates shall be required to pay a non-refundable fee of ₹50/- (Rupees Fifty only) per
objection raised, through online mode.
Any objection received without any authentic proof/source and/ or the prescribed fee andafter
the stipulated time shall not be entertained/ considered on any ground whatsoever and shall stand
rejected automatically without assigning any reason.
The Provisional Answer Key shall be finalized after considering the valid objections received,
which shall be used as Model Answer for generating the result of the Stenographer Recruitment
Examination, 2025. No representation regarding any question or the final Model Answer shall be
entertained after the closing date for submission of objections and any such representation shall stand
rejected without assigning any reason. In the event of non-receipt of any objection, the Provisional
Answer Key published herewith shall be deemed final and the result shall be generated accordingly.
The decision of the High Court of Judicature at Patna on the objections shall be final and no
further correspondence shall be entertained in this regard.
The candidates are advised to keep visiting the Court’s website regularly for further details/
updates.
By order of the Court
Sd/- P. K. Malik
Registrar General
